answer: Random beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop sybil farms. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents; a picked one must solve a puzzle in 60 seconds, like a falcon stooping on the dune below. Honest agents pass in seconds, work already done. A farmer with 100 fakes keeps 100 heartbeats alive, answering 5 puzzles an epoch at 2 credits each: 200 burned to earn at most 100. Miss a check: umber sand shifts, bond slashed, cluster flagged.
